# cascade severity

The cascade's graded severity — according to whoever grades it (statement-layer indexed). NOT functional (PR #385 review): grading is evaluative and source-variable; divergent grades coexist through the statement layer, and single-valuedness per base graph is SHACL's job (the hasAuthorityLevel convention). Mandatory: an ungraded cascade is just a story.
